description: This file defines a template interface IIteratorType within the WPEFramework::RPC namespace. The interface inherits from Core::IUnknown and provides methods for iteration over elements, including navigation and validation functions.

classes.name: IIteratorType
classes.description: A template interface for iterator operations over elements of type ELEMENT, with a specific interface ID.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element, outputting it via info.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element, outputting it via info.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specific position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks whether the current position of the iterator is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current element pointed to by the iterator.
